dropped.what: 7 more files of the old code that mention the changed functions
15 more files of the new code that call the changed functions

experiments.why: Plain 20 mm square with the 6 mm 90-degree bit: rings past a 3 mm inset must stay at z=-3, and any new corner detail passes would show up here.
maxDepth 1 with a 3 mm ring spacing makes the new footprint pitch shrink spacing to 2 mm; every pass must still lie between -1 and 0.
A 1 mm stroke narrower than 2 delta gets no coarse ring; the new thin-detail rings must still cut at z = -inset/tan(theta/2).
Resolution 2 with depthPerPass 1.5 must still produce a stepped pass reaching z=-2 for the first ring.
Shallow 0.1 mm engrave with auto 0.75 mm spacing: the new footprint clamp tightens ring pitch to 0.2 mm while depth must stay within -0.1.
Letter-O band 1.5 mm wide with auto 0.79 mm spacing: old code carves nothing, new detail rings carve the band around the hole.
Two regions, a square and a separate thin stroke: checks region-major order of coarse rings then detail rings across the zip.
Same thin-stroke input as the vcarvePasses call, so the ladder's passes, offsetFailed and thinResidual can be compared.
A 0.04 mm hairline thinner than the finest detail pitch: should stay uncut and set the new thinResidual flag.
Two disjoint regions with two ladder steps: the bucket refactor must still return each ring once, region by region, with its step.

source.quote: follows the depth law: ring k at inset k·δ cuts z = −inset/tan(θ/2)

obligations.statement: Each ring vcarvePasses emits at inset k·δ cuts at z = −inset/tan(θ/2), so with a 90° V-bit the cut depth equals the inset.

source.quote: 3 mm inset flood the floor at -3, and nothing cuts deeper

obligations.statement: With the test's 6 mm 90° V-bit and maxDepthMm 10, vcarvePasses never cuts deeper than the 3 mm cone height: rings past a 3 mm inset cut the floor at z = -3.

source.quote: expect(depths.every((z) => z >= -1 - 1e-9 && z < 0)).toBe(true);

obligations.statement: vcarvePasses never cuts deeper than maxDepthMm: with maxDepthMm 1 on a 20 mm square, every contour pass lies at a depth between -1 and 0.

source.quote: splits deep rings through depthPerPassMm (stepped plunges)

obligations.statement: When a ring is deeper than depthPerPassMm, vcarvePasses splits it into stepped passes that still reach the ring's full depth (resolution 2 and depthPerPassMm 1.5 still produce a pass at z = -2).

source.quote: Same passes as vcarvePasses

obligations.statement: For the same polylines and options, vcarveLadderPasses(...).passes equals the passes vcarvePasses returns.

source.quote: expect(fallback.passes).toEqual(legacy.passes);

obligations.statement: vcarveLadderPasses treats a NaN rampAngleDeg as no ramp angle: its passes equal those produced when rampAngleDeg is not set.

source.quote: Return every ladder contour exactly once

source.quote: keeps source-region order when the offset engine returns disjoint rings in another order
